nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of contract owner, written in constructor from msg.sender and updated in transferOwnership.
StandardToken.totalSupply: public total token supply, set in HC constructor and reduced in burn.
StandardToken.balances: mapping(address=>uint256) of token balances, mutated by transfer, transferFrom and burn.
StandardToken.allowed: nested allowance mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) mutated by approve, transferFrom, increaseApproval and decreaseApproval.
HC.name: constant token name 'HalkCoin'.
HC.symbol: constant token symbol 'HC'.
HC.decimals: constant 18 token decimals.
HC.initialSupply: constant 32768 * 10**decimals computed at compile time.
StandardToken.transfer(address,uint256): moves tokens from msg.sender to _to, uses SafeMath sub/add on balances.
StandardToken.balanceOf(address): view returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256): allowance-based transfer, mutates balances and allowed via SafeMath.
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256): sets allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
StandardToken.allowance(address,address): view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
StandardToken.increaseApproval(address,uint): adds _addedValue to allowance using SafeMath.add.
StandardToken.decreaseApproval(address,uint): subtracts from allowance using SafeMath.sub with clamp to zero.
BurnableToken.burn(uint256): destroys _value tokens from msg.sender and reduces totalSupply.
Ownable.transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner function reassigning owner to newOwner.
Ownable constructor: sets owner = msg.sender.
HC constructor: mints initialSupply to msg.sender and sets totalSupply.
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) guard on privileged functions.
SafeMath.add(uint256,uint256): asserted addition.
SafeMath.sub(uint256,uint256): asserted subtraction.
SafeMath.mul(uint256,uint256): asserted multiplication with zero short-circuit.
SafeMath.div(uint256,uint256): unprotected division (no zero check).
msg.sender used in transfer as the debit account and balances index.
msg.sender used in transferFrom as spender and allowance index.
msg.sender used in approve as allowance owner index.
msg.sender used in burn as burner account.
msg.sender used in Ownable constructor to assign owner.
Arithmetic credits balances[_to] via SafeMath.add inside transfer.
Arithmetic debits balances[msg.sender] via SafeMath.sub inside transfer.
Arithmetic debits balances[_from] via SafeMath.sub inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic credits balances[_to] via SafeMath.add inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic reduces allowed[_from][msg.sender] via SafeMath.sub inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender] via SafeMath.add in increaseApproval.
Arithmetic subtracts from allowed[msg.sender][_spender] via SafeMath.sub in decreaseApproval.
Arithmetic debits balances[burner] via SafeMath.sub in burn.
Arithmetic reduces totalSupply via SafeMath.sub in burn.
Arithmetic multiplication a*b with division assertion in SafeMath.mul.
Arithmetic addition a+b with assertion in SafeMath.add.
Arithmetic subtraction a-b with assertion in SafeMath.sub.
Compile-time arithmetic 32768 * 10**decimals producing initialSupply.
transfer parameter _to: destination address.
transfer parameter _value: amount transferred.
balanceOf parameter _owner: queried account.
transferFrom parameter _from: source account.
transferFrom parameter _to: destination account.
transferFrom parameter _value: amount transferred.
approve parameter _spender: approved account.
approve parameter _value: allowance amount.
allowance parameter _owner: allowance owner.
allowance parameter _spender: allowance spender.
increaseApproval parameter _spender: spender whose allowance is raised.
increaseApproval parameter _addedValue: increment amount.
decreaseApproval parameter _spender: spender whose allowance is lowered.
decreaseApproval parameter _subtractedValue: decrement amount.
burn parameter _value: amount of tokens destroyed.
transferOwnership parameter newOwner: new owner address.
transferFrom local _allowance caching allowed[_from][msg.sender].
decreaseApproval local oldValue caching current allowance.
burn local burner assigned from msg.sender.

edges.reason: HC constructor writes totalSupply = initialSupply, propagating arithmetic initial supply into state.
HC constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with initialSupply.
msg.sender is the recipient of the full initial supply in the HC constructor.
Arithmetic expression 32768 * 10**decimals produces the initialSupply constant.
msg.sender is used as the debit account inside transfer.
transfer executes the balances[_to] addition operation.
transfer executes the balances[msg.sender] subtraction operation.
Addition result is written back into the balances mapping.
Subtraction result is written back into the balances mapping.
transfer calls SafeMath.add for the credit.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub for the debit.
msg.sender acts as spender in transferFrom and indexes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom executes the balances[_from] subtraction.
transferFrom executes the balances[_to] addition.
transferFrom reduces the caller allowance.
Subtraction result is written into balances[_from].
Addition result is written into balances[_to].
Allowance subtraction result is written into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom relies on SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom caches allowed[_from][msg.sender] into the _allowance local.
The cached _allowance value flows into the allowance subtraction operation.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written in approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value.
increaseApproval performs an addition on the allowance.
Increase result is written into the allowed mapping.
increaseApproval calls SafeMath.add on the current allowance.
decreaseApproval performs a subtraction on the allowance.
Decrease result is written into the allowed mapping.
decreaseApproval calls SafeMath.sub on the current allowance.
decreaseApproval caches the current allowance into oldValue.
oldValue flows into the allowance subtraction operation.
msg.sender is the burner account in burn.
burn subtracts _value from balances[burner].
burn subtracts _value from totalSupply.
Burn subtraction result is written into the balances mapping.
Burn subtraction result is written into totalSupply.
burn calls SafeMath.sub for balance and supply reduction.
burn assigns burner = msg.sender before debiting.
burner indexes the balance subtraction operation.

transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a transient parameter of transfer and should be folded into the function node.
_value only carries the transfer amount into the function body.
_owner is the sole lookup key of the balanceOf view function.
_from is a transient source address parameter of transferFrom.
_to is a transient destination address parameter of transferFrom.
_value is the transient amount parameter of transferFrom.
_spender only keys the allowance mapping inside approve.
_value is the transient allowance amount in approve.
_owner is a transient lookup key in the allowance view.
_spender is a transient lookup key in the allowance view.
_spender is a transient allowance key in increaseApproval.
_addedValue directly feeds the allowance addition operation.
_spender is a transient allowance key in decreaseApproval.
_subtractedValue directly feeds the allowance subtraction operation.
_value is the transient burn amount parameter.
newOwner is the transient address reassigned to owner.
_allowance is a short-lived cache of allowed[_from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
oldValue is a short-lived cache of the current allowance inside decreaseApproval.
burner is just an alias of msg.sender inside burn.
